requirements: Requires FTK Mod Framework 1.7.0 or a compatible later 1.x release. Equipment Exchange is built into the framework; no separate currency mod is needed.
Bounded single-player gameplay verified on the listed macOS game build; Windows, Linux and co-op remain unverified.
Complete skinset fit, every display view, token supply and long-campaign balance remain under review.
Generated artwork has separate terms; see the source and release asset ASSET-LICENSE.md.
contentChanges: Uses a two-sentence flavor description, compact native-style class ability labels, and a Novice Hammer plus Novice Aegis starting kit.
Paladin class retains Guard and Cleansing March, which prevents new Poison and Curse while exploring.
Paladin owns Censure and Smite while an eligible hammer is equipped. Paladin hammers offer only native Strike; native hammers retain their original actions.
Smite deals magic damage and can stun on a perfect cast; Censure Resistance reduction increases its damage.
Mercy, Verdict and Censure armor sets change Guard, healing and attack tradeoffs when equipped.
Equipment Exchange supplies shared Guild Tokens and the native Back Alley vendor. The vendor shows only gear for the buying character's class and hides backpack and equipped copies.
changelog: Paladin 2.0.0 adds hammer-gated class actions, equipped armor roles, and Guild Token acquisition through the framework Equipment Exchange. Requires framework 1.7.0.
